title: Clearing the delivery lane

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The flat trolley’s at the repair bench until noon. Where should these empty roll cages go?
turns.zh: 平板推車會在維修臺待到中午。這些空籠車該放哪裡？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: In the marked square by the roller door. Keep the yellow lane clear. A delivery van will use it in a few minutes.
turns.zh: 放在捲門旁畫有標線的方格內。黃色通道別堵住，幾分鐘後會有送貨車要用。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The square’s clear. Do the cages go on that van?
turns.zh: 方格是空的。籠車要搬上那輛送貨車嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, it’s delivering parts. Our truck will take the empty cages back this afternoon.
turns.zh: 不用，那輛車是來送零件的。下午用我們的貨車把空籠車送回去。
